title: Google Vertex AI
description: Gemini and the open models Google serves on Vertex AI (gpt-oss, DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama…): Tomrade uses the credentials gcloud already holds, or a Vertex AI API key, and talks to Gemini through its own API, Google Search included.

why.fs: Reads the Application Default Credentials file that `gcloud auth application-default login` wrote (or the one GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS names), to sign in to Google with it. It reads no other file.
why.exec: Runs the Google Cloud CLI (gcloud config get-value project, gcloud config config-helper) to use the project and credentials you already set up for it, so you need not paste a key. It runs nothing else.
